grounding.excerpt: 4Q3   Lowest four-day average flow rate expected to occur once every three-years

grounding.note: Surrounding fact-sheet pages provide document abbreviations and permit metadata only; they do not specify measurement location, four-day averaging method, or recurrence interpretation for 4Q3.

rationale: The obligation demands identification of the specific hydrologic quantity denoted by 4Q3 when referenced in NM0020583 permit provisions, including measurement location, method for computing the four-day average, and recurrence interpretation of 'once every three-years.' The packet's only substantive 4Q3 evidence is the glossary line quoted above. That definition names a general flow statistic but does not ground where it is measured, how the four-day average is computed, or how 'once every three-years' is to be interpreted statistically or procedurally. The packet itself records that it may be evidence-insufficient. ACCEPT would require establishing those missing semantic components from evidence; REJECT would require establishing that the demanded determination is foreclosed. Neither burden is met. Per P5, unsupported uncertainty is preferred to unsupported semantic closure.
